stem_book: In the arrangement shown, a spool of mass m and moment of inertia I (inner radius R, outer radius 2R) rests with its outer rim on a plank of mass M lying on an incline of angle θ. A rope wound on the inner drum leaves it on the side facing the plank and is tied, parallel to the incline, to a fixed wall at the top. Friction between the spool and the plank is sufficient to prevent sliding; there is no slipping of the rope. The system starts from rest. Column-I: (A) When m > M and there is no friction between the plank and the inclined surface. (B) When M > m and there is no friction between the plank and the inclined surface. (C) When m = M and there is no friction between the plank and the inclined surface. (D) When m = M and the friction coefficient between the plank and the inclined surface is tanθ. Column-II: (P) Plank will ascend (Q) Plank will descend (R) Plank will remain stationary (S) Spool may rotate clockwise (T) Spool may rotate anticlockwise.
